title: Do you know where … ? · I don’t know what … и т. д.

exercises.instruction: Ответьте на вопросы, используя I don’t know where/when/why … и т. д.

answers: I don’t know where they’ve gone.
I don’t know where she is.

items.prompt: Is the castle very old? (how old)
answers: I don’t know how old it is.
I don’t know when he’ll be here.

items.prompt: Was he angry because I was late? (why)
answers: I don’t know why he was angry.

items.prompt: Has Emily lived here a long time? (how long)
answers: I don’t know how long she has lived here.
how airplanes fly
where Susan works
what Peter said
why he went home early
